name: Launchpad sample catalog
description: Fictional services for a local-first engineering workshop. These records do not represent deployed workloads.

services.name: API Gateway
services.description: The front door for product APIs. Routes requests, applies quotas, and keeps request IDs consistent across services.

services.name: Model Gateway
services.description: A single interface for model requests, with provider routing, request budgets, and structured response handling.

services.name: Inference API
services.description: Serves prediction requests and tracks model versions so product teams can reproduce each inference result.

services.name: Prompt Registry
services.description: Versioned prompt templates with explicit input contracts. Shared by evaluation jobs and application services.

services.name: Eval Runner
services.description: Executes repeatable evaluation suites and produces structured result artifacts for model and prompt changes.

services.name: Billing Worker
services.description: Aggregates usage events into billing periods and checks that retries never create duplicate ledger entries.

services.name: Event Worker
services.description: Processes application events, retries transient failures, and routes exhausted messages to a review queue.

services.name: Docs Site
services.description: The engineering handbook: architecture notes, onboarding guides, and conventions for contributing to the platform.
